text:
lena: quick sync proposal Config Drift Detector + Auto-Remediate. goal: detect when runtime config diverges from control-plane (stale caches, failed propagation, manual hotfixes) and offer safe remediation steps.

josh: what's the detection signal? hashes, version ids, or sampling?
lena: hybrid: per-flag checksum (sha256 of effective config) + sampled instance heartbeats. On mismatch we surface affected nodes, last-propagation-ts, and a divergence score.
ravi: if we auto-remediate, how do we avoid flipping state we intentionally changed (hotfixes)? Need an approval window or dry-run.
lena: plan: remediation modes: notify-only, auto-retry-propagation (best-effort), or auto-rollback-to-control (only for low-risk flags). Auto-actions require preconfigured policy per-flag.
maya: Console UX: new "Drift" tab on flag page showing timeline of checksum changes, affected cohorts, manual overrides, and a one-click dry-run remediation that simulates without touching runtimes. Provide human-friendly explanation for PMs.
devon: telemetry: config.checksum_mismatch_count, config.propagation_retry_count, config.auto_remediate_count, config.manual_fix_count. Alerts when mismatch_count > 3 across > 2 regions in 5m.
cara: SRE: default: do not auto-rollback infra-critical flags. Allow auto-retry propagation with exponential backoff and jitter. If retries fail, create a high-priority incident and mark flag as "needs human review" in Console.
tori: security: log all remediation attempts in audit log with who approved and what diff applied. Overrides require owner + two approvers for high-risk flags.
josh: implementation: control plane keeps authoritative checksum, runtimes periodically push local checksum. For hot path, when a node fails to apply config, it should emit an event; detector reconciles on a small window and triggers remediation. Keep local checks cheap (sha256 of small canonical JSON).
ravi: edge-case: transient network partition causing temporary divergence. Detector should require sustained mismatch for a window (e.g., 60s with 3 samples) before alerting or auto-action.
maya: Console copy when drift detected: short plain-English reason + "what we recommend" + actions: simulate, retry propagation, request manual rollback. Add a "request emergency override" button that queues a reviewed operation.
devon: I'll propose SLOs & alert thresholds. Starting point: alert when mismatch_score > 0.8 across > 2 nodes for > 60s or mismatch_count >= 5 in 5m.
cara: runbook: investigate timeline -> check recent deploys & manual changes -> attempt propagation retry -> if still failing, escalate to infra and product.
josh: perf: checksum compute must be microsecond-level per config to not slow startup. Use canonical stable serialization and incremental hashing where possible.
lena: preflight: any flag enabling auto-remediate must have telemetry hooks and a human-approval policy. configbot: enforce.
configbot: preflight: schema OK. WARNING: telemetry bindings missing: config.propagation_retry_count. Recommend auto-add or fail preflight.
tori: can configbot offer a one-click remediation demo in Console for owners? would help trust.
lena: yes, demo + dry-run mode planned. Action items: lena -> RFC + prototype; josh -> cheap checksum lib + perf; devon -> SLOs/alerts; cara -> runbook + incident playbook; maya -> Console mocks and copy; tori -> audit/approval policy. reconvene after PoC.
configbot: reminder: create RFC under /eng/flags/rfcs and attach preflight id 4360000123.
lena: thanks all :white_check_mark:
